description: This file defines a controller class 'SaveOAuthClientController' within the OrangeHRM OAuth plugin. The controller extends an abstract Vue controller and is responsible for preparing a Vue component ('oauth-client-save') with optional properties based on the request parameters. Its main function is to set up the Vue component with an 'id' property if provided in the request query.

classes.name: SaveOAuthClientController
classes.description: A controller that prepares a Vue component for saving OAuth client details, optionally pre-populating with an 'id' based on request query parameters.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the Vue component before rendering, adding an 'id' property if it exists in the request query.
